# MoltDisk

> MoltDisk is a free, native macOS app that frees up disk space on developer Macs. It finds what developer tools leave behind (node_modules and build folders in any language, Xcode DerivedData, old iOS simulators and runtimes, package manager caches, unused editor extensions, app caches and logs), shows the size and a safety label for every item, and moves only what you tick to the Trash.

Requirements: macOS 15 Sequoia or later, Apple silicon. Price: free, no subscription. License: source-available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (free for personal and noncommercial use; no selling or commercial use without permission). Install: `curl -fsSL https://moltdisk.vercel.app/install.sh | sh` or `brew tap joe-watson-dev/moltdisk https://github.com/joe-watson-dev/moltdisk && brew trust joe-watson-dev/moltdisk && brew install --cask moltdisk`. The app is ad-hoc signed, not notarized: the first time, open System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.

## What it cleans

- Project leftovers: node_modules, .next, dist, build, target (Maven, Rust), .gradle, .venv and __pycache__, bin/obj (.NET), .build (SwiftPM), Pods, .dart_tool and more. node_modules is recognised by name; generic names like build, dist, bin or target only count when the project file next to them (package.json, pom.xml, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml…) proves it.
- Xcode: DerivedData, Archives, iOS DeviceSupport, SwiftUI Previews.
- iOS simulators and runtimes, removed with `xcrun simctl delete` / `simctl runtime delete`, never `rm`.
- Package caches: npm, npx, pnpm, Yarn, Bun, Homebrew, CocoaPods, Gradle, Maven, NuGet, pub, Composer, Go, Cargo, pip, SwiftPM, Deno.
- Editors and IDEs: VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, Kiro, VSCodium and other VS Code-based editors (each extension with its real name and last use), JetBrains IDEs and Android Studio (old versions left after upgrades, caches, logs).
- Applications: uninstalls apps completely (the app plus its caches, settings, containers, saved state and other files in ~/Library), and lists leftovers of apps that were already deleted. Running apps are locked; Apple apps are never offered.
- App caches (Chrome, Brave, Edge, Arc, Slack, Discord, Notion and other Electron apps), logs, large files in Downloads, and the Trash.

## Safety

- Files go to the Trash by default; permanent delete is an explicit option.
- Caches and data of running apps are locked and checked again right before deleting.
- Extensions used in the last 30 days, recently installed ones and the active theme are locked.
- A hard guard refuses anything outside the home folder and protected folders such as Documents, Desktop, Keychains, Preferences, Containers and Application Support (except known cache folders).
- Not covered: Time Machine local snapshots, root-owned simulator volumes in /Library/Developer/CoreSimulator, Homebrew in /opt/homebrew (use `brew cleanup`).
